FOCUS PLUS GOLD
Seasonic engineers have created a brand new product line based on advanced technology emanating from many years of intensive active research. The result of this development is the solid FOCUS+ Series, which implements modern design and shows outstanding electrical performance. This power supply is small and entirely modular, which will be hard to resist. It is available in 80 PLUS® Platinum and Gold efficiency ratings.
The FOCUS PLUS Gold Series achieves 80 PLUS® Gold certification with its 90 % efficiency at 50 % system load.

FLUID DYNAMIC FAN BEARING
High performance Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fans are designed to take advantage of the impact absorbance effects of oil. They are extremely reliable and generate considerably less operating noise and heat than ball bearing fans. The lubrication of the bearing surface reduces friction and vibration and therefore lowers overall power consumption. Due to the effortless, quieter rotations and its robust construction, this reliable fan technology also greatly increases the lifespan of the fan.
When the fan shaft rotates, high pressure oil drifts along the grooves of the bearing sleeve to generate a thin layer of lubrication between the bearing faces.
As the speed increases, so does dynamic oil pressure and the shaft is lifted from the bearing to create smooth, effortless rotations. The herringbone shape of the groves helps to efficiently channel the lubricant and avert leakage.

Hybrid Silent Fan Control of focus plus gold – Fanless up to about 30 % load
The industry’s first, Seasonic patented, advanced three-phased thermal control achieves optimal balance between silence and cooling. This Hybrid Silent Fan Control functions in three operational stages: Fanless Mode, Silent Mode, and Cooling Mode.

FAQ
What wattage options are available in the Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series?
The Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series comes with 750W, 650W, 550W, and 450W models. This power capacity is adequate enough for daily tasks around the home or office, as well as gaming systems. More about their specifications and case of use, you can find on our website.
Is the Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series fully modular for easier cable management?
Yes. This Seasonic PSU series has a fully modular cable design. This cable design is fully flexible in connecting the PC components you need and makes cable management much easier. It also fits transparent cases where aesthetic look is a priority.
What efficiency certification does the Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series have?
This PSU series is 80 PLUS® Gold certified. This means the power supply converts power more efficiently, wasting less heat and lowering power consumption. Talking in numbers, it provides 87% of efficiency under full load, and 90% under 50% load.
How compact is the Seasonic FOCUS Gold power supply series?
The Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series has pretty compact dimensions – 140 mm × 150 mm × 86 mm. Such a size makes it easy to install these PSUs into most ATX-compatible cases.
What warranty is included with the Seasonic FOCUS Gold PSU series?
The FOCUS Gold PSU series comes with a 7-year warranty from the manufacturer. This term additionally demonstrates the series's reliability and stable operation over years of use.

High performance Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fans are designed to take advantage of the impact absorbance effects of oil. They are extremely reliable and generate considerably less operating noise and heat than ball bearing fans. The lubrication of the bearing surface reduces friction and vibration and therefore lowers overall power consumption. Due to the effortless, quieter rotations and its robust construction, this reliable fan technology also greatly increases the lifespan of the fan.
When the fan shaft rotates, high pressure oil drifts along the grooves of the bearing sleeve to generate a thin layer of lubrication between the bearing faces.

As the speed increases, so does dynamic oil pressure and the shaft is lifted from the bearing to create smooth, effortless rotations. The herringbone shape of the groves helps to efficiently channel the lubricant and avert leakage.

Hybrid Silent Fan Control of focus plus gold – Fanless up to about 30 % load

The industry’s first, Seasonic patented, advanced three-phased thermal control achieves optimal balance between silence and cooling. This Hybrid Silent Fan Control functions in three operational stages: Fanless Mode, Silent Mode, and Cooling Mode.
